name: Icon tiles
for: A grid of features where each icon chip is filled with the effect, like an app icon: one canvas seen through every chip, so the chips are related but each a little different.
how: windows(): one still effect host over the grid, masked to the chips' boxes (12px radius, the --r-md token); the glyphs sit above it in the accent ink. Before the canvas draws, each chip is plain accent.
rules: Glyphs in the accent ink, drawn by hand or from one icon set; never brand logos here.
Still: no drift and no flicker in chips this small.
Chip radius is the --r-md token (12px), as for every chip in the kit.
One tile group with filled chips per page.
a11y: Chips are decorative (aria-hidden); every tile has a heading and a sentence. The effect is still.
